items.period: Shang oracle script style (ancient period represented; vector file uploaded 2006 and revised 2018)
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 上 in Shang oracle-script style, a candidate for illustrating the early marker-above-a-reference-line analysis.
items.alt: A redrawn oracle-script form of 上 shown as a short mark above a longer baseline.
items.selection_reason: It directly illustrates the early graph type relevant to the indicative analysis; the Commons page names the form and its character-specific data sources.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the Commons description page.

items.period: Seal-script style represented; modern vector file first uploaded 2006 and revised 2018
items.tradition: Shuowen seal-script style; modern digital redraw
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 上 in a seal-script style, useful for comparing a later standardized graphic form with the oracle-style candidate.
items.alt: A redrawn seal-script form of 上.
items.selection_reason: Pairs an identified later script style with the oracle-style candidate and shows graphic history as a change in representation, not an artifact photograph.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the Commons description page. The page also mentions a separate Richard Sears source arrangement; selection relies on the stated Commons file license.

limitations.text: These are modern digital redrawings labeled by script style, not photographs or direct facsimiles of dated artifacts; captions should preserve that distinction.
The two Commons candidates help compare script styles but do not adjudicate the disagreement over whether the earliest baseline was curved.
